name: A proud mood fades back to happy after 5 minutes
case: The agent's tests fail twice and then pass, so Boop turns proud. It stays proud through a quick routine turn a minute later. Five minutes after it turned proud, the pride has faded: by the end of the next quick turn Boop is happy again, with a happy face at most.
why: plan/steering/guide.md and plan/steering/mood/proud.md: the pass comes over a minute after the first failure, since a mood holds while it's under a minute old; proud stays through routine turns and goes back to happy 5 minutes after the mood changed to it; the change back shows, with a happy face, on whichever line brings it (the turn start or its finish)
